First, convert 33 weeks and 1 day to days:  
33 weeks × 7 days = 231 days, plus 1 day = 232 days.  

Subtract 232 days from 1633-06-08:  
June 8, 1633 minus 232 days.  

Count back:  
June has 30 days, so back to May: June 8 → May 9 is 30 days (June 8 to June 1 = 8 days earlier in June, so 30 total days back to May 9? Let's do systematically):  

Better:  
From 1633-06-08:  
Back 8 days → 1633-05-31.  
Back 30 more days → 1633-05-01.  
Remaining days: 232 − 8 − 30 = 194 days left.  

April has 30 days: back to 1633-04-01 → 30 days, left 164.  
March has 31 days: back to 1633-03-01 → 31 days, left 133.  
February 1633 has 28 days (not leap year: 1633 not divisible by 4) → back to 1633-02-01 → 28 days, left 105.  
January has 31 days: back to 1633-01-01 → 31 days, left 74.  

Now into 1632:  
December 1632 has 31 days: back to 1632-12-01 → 31 days, left 43.  
November 1632 has 30 days: back to 1632-11-01 → 30 days, left 13.  
October 1632 has 31 days: back 13 days from 1632-11-01 → 1632-10-19 (since Oct has 31 days: Oct 19 to Oct 31 is 13 days earlier).  

Check:  
From 1632-11-01 back 1 day = Oct 31, back 13 total days = Oct 19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1632-10-19
